top_issues.text: F2/F3 KG MARGINAL-LIFT DONE + NEGATIVE (coordinator dispatch 2026-06-25/26). Rasterized fossick's F2 KG feature export onto the SERVED grids (25 m in-box, 100 m district) with the two over-attribution guards: extent-aware attribution (point->1 cell; claim_polygon->covered cells; area_footprint->200 m disc, NOT a centroid; district->dropped from cells) + USGS OFR 2021-1041 per-cell cap (single highest-scoring ground, coverage capped at 1). src/ai_minerals/kg_rasterize.py + scripts/nome_placer/f3_kg_marginal_lift.py; 10 unit tests green (tests/test_kg_rasterize.py). Graded placer_onshore/lode_inbox/lode_district under F1's leak_guarded_evaluate (contiguous folds, r=1 km, residual-variogram blocks, seed 42); arms base/kg_present/kg_spatial/kg/prose/kg_prose/kg_label. Naive marginal change +0.19..+0.34 (placer 0.679->0.989, lode_district 0.633->0.972) is TARGET LEAKAGE via a coverage confound: a lone kg_present bit reproduces nearly all of it because the KG features and the labels share ONE occurrence inventory with NO leave-one-out, and the r=1 km dead-zone cannot remove a test cell's own feature value. Added the leak-free arm kg_loo (scripts/nome_placer/f3_kg_loo.py): fold-aware leave-one-out spatial fields ONLY (per fold the visible ground set excludes the held-out blocks + the cell's own record; coverage + prose features dropped), with a paired class-stratified bootstrap CI. RESULT: the gain collapses -- placer -0.018 (-0.069,+0.035), lode_inbox -0.003 (-0.063,+0.056), lode_district -0.083 (-0.142,-0.027, significantly negative). The recomputed base matches the leaky-run base to 0.0000 on all three, so kg_loo is graded on IDENTICAL folds. NO leak-free KG signal survived; this is the planned negative, not a tuning bug. Report docs/f3_kg_marginal_lift.md; numbers data/derived/nome_placer/f3_kg_marginal_lift/{f3_kg_marginal_lift,f3_kg_loo}.{json,csv} (committed via add -f). PR opened off origin/main; not merged, not deployed. Real next test = DISJOINT inventories (label on ARDF, proximity features on KARDEX-only) so feature and label are not the same record.

F1 LEAK-GUARDED SPATIAL-CV HARNESS DONE (coordinator dispatch 2026-06-25, gates the Foundation-first run). Built src/ai_minerals/spatial_cv.py: residual-variogram block sizing (spherical fit on OOF residuals, block edge = 2x range), contiguous-region folds, Airola-2018 dead-zone (drops training within r=1km of any test point, above the 400-800m F2 proximity buffers), in-box-vs-district AUC per run. 10 unit tests green (tests/test_spatial_cv.py). Documented equivalent of verde.BlockKFold/spacv; NO new dependency added. Re-baseline (scripts/nome_placer/f1_leak_guarded_rebaseline.py, deterministic seed 42): placer onshore 0.733->0.679; lode in-box 0.802->0.806; lode district 0.620->0.633. ACCEPTANCE MET: the lode collapse reproduces (in-box 0.806 >> district 0.633) on the existing structural features; placer drops ~0.05 (the autocorrelation leak in the old no-buffer number). Offline only -- does NOT change the served goldbug placer raster (still the 0.733-trained surface). Report docs/f1_leak_guarded_cv_rebaseline.md; numbers data/derived/nome_placer/f1_rebaseline/{json,csv}. ESCALATED TO COORDINATOR (one decision): fold-assignment strategy moves district AUC ~0.10 (scattered 0.731 vs contiguous 0.633); scattered variogram-blocks interpolate the ~30km elevation gradient and HIDE the collapse, so the dispatch's 'distribute positives evenly across folds' conflicts with 'reproduce the collapse' for clustered positives. Both strategies implemented+reported; headline is contiguous (meets acceptance). PR opened off origin/main for Sky review; F2 (KG covariates) + F3 (marginal-lift) consume this module. Not merged, not deployed.

ARDF FULL-TEXT RE-EXPORT (coordinator 2026-06-24, 'ARDF description text missing from KG'): root cause is NOT the export -- the ARDF shapefile (data/raw/ardf/ardf/ardf.shp) caps every .dbf text field at 255 chars, and ardf.met's process note confirms the 5 long fields (Location, Geologic Description, Workings, Comments, References) exceed 255 and were truncated when the shapefile was built. So the 2026-06-21 export carried the narrative COLUMNS but only 255-char stubs; the full text was never in the shapefile. scripts/nome_placer/enrich_ardf_fulltext.py keeps the validated WGS84 geometry from 6e99b9a EXACTLY (0/286 coords changed; NM101 still -165.286858,64.645544) and replaces the stubs with full text pulled per-record from mrdata's JSON service (https://mrdata.usgs.gov/ardf/json/<num>, full DB not shapefile; needs a real User-Agent or it 403s). 286 records, no fetch failures; geol_desc max 255->6701, location ->1158, work_expl ->3480; adds references (full bibliography) + reporter. Schema is a strict superset of the prior export. Staged at handoff/outbox/2026-06-24-ardf-nome-fulltext/ for the coordinator to route to fossick. DOWNSTREAM NOTE: the 2026-06-21 export DID contain the 255-char stubs, but kg_nome.jsonld has zero long-text, so fossick's re-ingest/KG build (b5dafba) dropped even the stubs -- fossick must carry the narrative columns through to occurrence nodes; re-export alone will not surface text in kg.html.
